```yaml
name: Publish Java Bulk CDK Base Image
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/**'

jobs:
  publish-base-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata for base image
        id: meta-base
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/source-declarative-manifest
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=7.6.5

      - name: Build and push base image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta-base.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta-base.outputs.labels }}
          build-args: |
            BASE_IMAGE_VERSION=7.6.5

      - name: Verify image push
        run: |
          docker pull ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/source-declarative-manifest:7.6.5
          echo "Base image successfully published"

  update-connector-version:
    needs: publish-base-image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Update connector version in metadata
        run: |
          sed -i 's/version: "4.4.18"/version: "4.4.19"/' airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml
          echo "Updated connector version to 4.4.19"

      - name: Update base image reference
        run: |
          sed -i 's/baseImage: source-declarative-manifest:7.6.1/baseImage: source-declarative-manifest:7.6.5/' airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml
          echo "Updated base image to 7.6.5"

      - name: Add changelog entry
        run: |
          echo "" >> docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md
          echo "### 4.4.19" >> docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md
          echo "- Updated CDK version from 7.6.1 to 7.6.5" >> docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md
          echo "- Includes latest CDK bug fixes and improvements" >> docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-gitlab/metadata.yaml docs/integrations/sources/gitlab.md
          git commit -m "chore(source-gitlab): Update CDK version from 7.6.1 to 7.6.5" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main || echo "Push failed, likely no changes"
```
